verdict.rationale: Radar is API-driven (review approve/reject endpoints, rules API, value lists) and has a documented CLI, plus sandbox test card numbers for reproducible testing, all of which support headless/CI use. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI pipelines, automated test suites, or non-interactive setup workflows tailored to CI. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guides, documented non-interactive setup, and evidence of headless integration examples.
